# ❤️ Lifesteal Essentials
**The Ultimate All-in-One Lifesteal Core for Modern Minecraft Servers**

Lifesteal Essentials is not just another lifesteal plugin; it is a complete, enterprise-grade server core designed to replace dozens of scattered plugins with a single, optimized, and visually stunning solution. Built for Paper 1.21+, it combines high-performance asynchronous systems with a premium "modern-server" aesthetic.

---

## 💎 Why Lifesteal Essentials?
Most "Essentials" plugins provide basic text-based commands. We provide a **GUI-First experience**. Every feature—from the Shop to personal Settings—is delivered through beautiful, interactive menus that support **Hex Gradients (MiniMessage)** and custom textures.

---

## 🚀 Key Features

### 🩸 Modern Lifesteal Core
*   **Heart Stealing:** Gain max health by slaying your enemies.
*   **Heart Withdrawal:** Use `/hearts withdraw <amount>` to turn your health into physical, tradable heart items.
*   **Heart Consumption:** Right-click hearts to instantly increase your max health.
*   **Death Bans:** Automated temp-bans when a player loses all hearts (configurable durations).
*   **Revival System:** Bring back fallen teammates with custom revival items.

### 🏪 Premium Economy & Market
*   **Auction House (`/ah`):** A fully featured, modern market for player-to-player trading.
*   **Dynamic Shop (`/shop`):** Categorized GUI shop for all your server needs.
*   **Triple-Currency System:** Supports **Money**, **Coins**, and **Shards** for complex server economies.
*   **Player Orders:** A unique market system for placing and fulfilling item requests.

### 🛡️ Social & Utility
*   **Advanced Teams:** Create teams, toggle friendly fire, and set team homes.
*   **Teleportation (TPA):** Modern TPA system with GUI confirmation screens.
*   **Private Vaults (`/pv`):** Secure, scalable player storage.
*   **Modern Chat:** Hoverable player profiles in chat showing stats, balances, and tags.
*   **Rank Support:** Integrated rank system with custom prefixes and permissions.

### 🎁 Rewards & Engagement
*   **Daily Rewards:** Keep players coming back with a tiered reward GUI.
*   **AFK Zones:** Reward your active players with shards just for being on the server.
*   **Crates:** Advanced crate system for keys and loot drops.
*   **Leaderboards:** 3D floating holograms for Kills, Wealth, and more.

---

## 🛠️ Player Commands
| Command | Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| `/hearts` | View health or withdraw hearts into items. |
| `/menu` | Open the main Lifesteal Hub GUI. |
| `/shop` | Open the server shop GUI. |
| `/ah` | Access the Auction House. |
| `/team` | Manage your lifesteal team. |
| `/vault` | Open your private player vaults. |
| `/settings` | Toggle personal preferences (Chat, Scoreboard, etc). |
| `Etc` | Many more essential commands. |

> **Note:** There are 50+ additional administration commands for operators (e.g., `/lsessentials reload`, `/eco`, `/rank`, `/crate`, `/leaderboard`, `/display`) to manage every aspect of the server.

---

## ⚙️ Requirements
*   **Platform:** Paper, Purpur, or Spigot (1.21+)
*   **Java:** 17 or higher
*   **Soft Depend:** PlaceholderAPI (Recommended for custom scoreboards)

---

## 🎨 Customizable Everything
Lifesteal Essentials uses **MiniMessage** for all messages and GUI titles. This means you can use modern hex gradients like `<gradient:#ff0000:#990000>Lifesteal Essentials</gradient>` to make your server stand out.

---
*Developed with ❤️ for the next generation of Lifesteal Servers.*
